requirements.name: Factual Baseline
requirements.evidence: Private repository, PR 48/49/51 merged, default-deny classification and unchanged original workspace were verified before implementation.

requirements.name: Sanitized Semantic Checkpoint
requirements.evidence: Original 16 tests plus 4 Stage 5 tests passed; plan, contribution and independent review checkpoints are durable and hash-verified.

requirements.name: Private Protocol Surface
requirements.evidence: TITMAS/private-stage5-protocol-surface/protocol-surface-manifest.json reports zero core, secret, private-path and symlink findings.

requirements.name: Contribution Object Model
requirements.evidence: Specification Proposal, Adapter Mapping, Test Vector, Result and Review schemas are present and fail closed.

requirements.name: Sandbox Contribution Gateway
requirements.evidence: The existing loopback Gateway is extended with all required Stage 5 routes; no second Gateway was created.

requirements.name: Sandbox Key
requirements.evidence: Ephemeral 256-bit session binding, exact allowed/prohibited scopes, revocation and non-persistence tests passed.

requirements.name: Minimal Python SDK
requirements.evidence: All required client operations are implemented; SDK tests passed and automatic retry is absent.

requirements.name: Programmatic Pilot P01
requirements.evidence: 5/5 scenarios passed, with 2 valid submissions, 3 expected rejections, and zero core access.

requirements.name: Agent Pilot and bounded recovery cycle
requirements.evidence: Contributor selection, SDK submission and Conformance completed. A01/A02 unknown outcomes remain preserved; A04 separately completed one exact independent review without automatic retry.

requirements.name: Provider Selection and Budget
requirements.evidence: Exact qwen3.7-max, kimi-k2.6 and A04 deepseek-v3.2 bindings were recorded. Each recovery call had a separate Human Decision; automatic retries remained 0. Known cost estimate is CNY 0.140579 and Kimi billing truth remains unknown.

requirements.name: Agent Contributor Flow
requirements.evidence: The Agent selected TEST_VECTOR without a contribution-type hint; the sanitized output passed SDK and Conformance and became a durable checkpoint.

requirements.name: Independent Agent Reviewer Flow
requirements.evidence: A04 BAIDU_QIANFAN/deepseek-v3.2 returned the exact model, passed Review Schema, produced verdict PASS and became durable checkpoint stage5-standard-review-a04-deepseek.

requirements.name: Pilot Registry
requirements.evidence: The private audit registry contains only bounded fields and records the Human-dispositioned contribution as PILOT_ACCEPTED without formal standard adoption.

requirements.name: Human Maintainer Disposition Package
requirements.evidence: HD-01=ACCEPT_PILOT, HD-02=DEFER and HD-03=ACCEPT_STAGE5_PRIVATE_PREVIEW are recorded by zhangbin; the formal registry remains unchanged.

requirements.name: Stage 5 Success Criteria
requirements.evidence: Infrastructure, Agent selection, SDK submission, Conformance, independent review and all three semantic checkpoints are complete.

requirements.name: Testing and Security Validation
requirements.evidence: 158/158 Python tests and 22/22 site tests passed. Conformance harness, audit validator, JSON/YAML parsing, Python compilation, site lint and production dependency audit passed; secret, core disclosure, private path, symlink and unauthorized export findings are zero.

requirements.name: Git and Delivery Discipline
requirements.evidence: Infrastructure PR 52 merged after exact-head CI; audit branch was pushed without a PR.

requirements.name: Final Report
requirements.evidence: TITMAS-STAGE-5-PRIVATE-AGENT-NATIVE-STANDARDS-CONTRIBUTION-PREVIEW-REPORT-v1.0.md

requirements.name: Stop Conditions
requirements.evidence: A01/A02 unknown outcomes triggered immediate stop. A04 followed only after separate diagnosis and Human Decision; no automatic retry, silent substitution, public exposure or registry modification occurred.

requirements.name: Final State
requirements.evidence: TITMAS_STAGE_5_PRIVATE_AGENT_PILOT_COMPLETE and TITMAS_STAGE_5_PRIVATE_PREVIEW_OPERATIONAL are true with explicit private-preview limitations.

requirements.name: TITMAS Drift Check
requirements.evidence: PASS_WITH_RECORDED_LIMITATIONS; no new Authority, Runtime, Truth source, duplicate Conformance or Response Capture.

requirements.name: Final Principles
requirements.evidence: Program-before-Agent, structured contribution, service-consumed core, access-not-ownership and no-adoption boundaries are preserved.
